text: According to the three-pass method for reading a paper, the first pass should take 1-3 hours and involves reading the methods in enough detail to reproduce a figure.
explanation: This description matches the THIRD pass (1-3 hours; detailed methods reading; attempting to reproduce a figure), not the first. The first pass is quick (5-10 minutes) and covers only the title, abstract, introduction, section headings, and concluding figures, just to decide whether the paper is worth a full read. Conflating the passes defeats the purpose of the method, which is to progressively deepen understanding only as needed.
